description: This file defines a Java class 'CreateGuarantorCommandHandler' responsible for handling 'CREATE' commands for guarantors within a loan portfolio application. It implements command processing to invoke the guarantor write platform service for creating guarantors.

classes.name: CreateGuarantorCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the creation of guarantors via command processing, invoking the corresponding write service.

methods.name: CreateGuarantorCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor injecting the guarantor write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the create guarantor command, delegating to the write platform service to create a guarantor.
